verdict.rationale: Graphite installs as a GitHub App on an org or personal account. AI reviews can be enabled in a few clicks with no configuration, and Graphite Agent then automatically reviews all new PRs, giving 'instant'/'immediate' feedback and leaving comments (comment exclusions control where it should not comment). Its suggestions integrate directly with GitHub, so they can be taken in one click. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that reviews post as native inline line-level comments in the GitHub PR thread, GitLab support (a community user reports it is GitHub-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration of review turnaround time.
